topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: When I stumbled upon the canvas, or rather, the skin, I felt a surge of energy, a deep resonance with the work that now lived beyond paper and paint. It was my piece, unmistakably mine, yet transformed by the vector of someone’s inner landscape. The lines, the colors, the way the shading played with light—it was as if my art had found a new, living gallery. I traced the contours with my gaze, each element a testament to the connection we sometimes seek through our creations. It was more than just art; it was a dialogue, a silent exchange of souls.
